rule: PDF, JPG, PNG and HEIC images, Excel and Word (xlsx, docx) up to 20 MB
stopped: Upload stopped: this file was not attached. Try again when the signal is better.
typeNotAllowed: This kind of file cannot be attached. Use PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC, or Excel and Word files (xlsx, docx).
tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB. Make it smaller or split it, then try again.
empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.
contentMismatch: The file content does not match its type; it may have been renamed. Send the original file.
unreadable: This photo cannot be used: the browser cannot open it to remove where it was taken. Choose a JPG or PNG photo.
failed: The upload did not work. Check your connection and try again.
harnessIntro: This page exists only on developer machines, to test attachments before the request forms exist.
